sections_en.text: Procedure: Visual inspection of the generator (I1-M1)
This document outlines the maintenance procedures on the generator I1, which must be performed monthly M1

The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mokhtar Gomaa Qarni, field-tested by Eng. Yasser Abdel Rahman at El Kureimat 2 Power Station, accepted by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud, General Manager of Electrical Maintenance, approved by Eng. Fathy El Sayed Ibrahim, Head of El Kureimat 2 Power Station Sector, and certified by Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab: Head of Technical Inspection and Quality Control Sector at Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company and MPIS Coordinator.
Issue a work order for the maintenance team, stating the occupational safety and health category of each individual
Fence off the work area at site and place warning signs
Wear the appropriate occupational safety and health equipment necessary for personal safety (safety shoes, protective helmet, overalls, gloves)
Note: the generator is in service
Complete wrench set (5 mm Allen key - ordinary screwdriver)
Steps for inspecting the carbon brushes of the grounding system and replacing them if necessary
Visually inspect to determine the brush length according to the marked change limit
Replace the brush, ensuring adequate pressure on the brush
Return the brushes and install them in the correct position, taking into account the direction of rotation for brush placement
Steps for inspecting the carbon brushes of the excitation system and replacing them if necessary
Measure the brush with the gauge stick and visually inspect to see whether it has reached the marked change limit
Replace the brush, ensuring adequate pressure on the brush
Return the brushes and install them in the correct position, taking into account the direction of rotation for brush placement
When replacing, the brushes must be replaced one after another, and two brushes must not be replaced at the same time
Ensure that no tools used or anything else are left inside the generator brush housing
Clean the air filter after dismantling it using wrenches
Clean the excitation and grounding brush holders
Clean the generator body from the outside
Clean the excitation system room from inside and outside
Inspect the brush holder springs by pressing them and observing the spring-back reaction

Procedure: Visual inspection of the generator (I1-M1)
Date of Next Review: March 2013
Introduction
This document outlines the maintenance procedures on the generator I1, which must be performed monthly M1
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mokhtar Gomaa Qarni, field-tested by Eng. Yasser Abdel Rahman at El Kureimat 2 Power Station, accepted by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud, General Manager of Electrical Maintenance, approved by Eng. Fathy El Sayed Ibrahim, Head of El Kureimat 2 Power Station Sector, and certified by Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab: Head of Technical Inspection and Quality Control Sector at Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company and MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
Issue a work order for the maintenance team, stating the occupational safety and health category of each individual
Fence off the work area at site and place warning signs
Wear the appropriate occupational safety and health equipment necessary for personal safety (safety shoes, protective helmet, overalls, gloves)
Note: the generator is in service
Tools and Equipment Used
Soft cloth pieces for cleaning
Carbon brushes for replacement
Service air
Complete wrench set (5 mm Allen key - ordinary screwdriver)
Brush length gauge stick
Procedures to be Carried Out
Steps for inspecting the carbon brushes of the grounding system and replacing them if necessary
Wear tested insulating gloves
1.
Visually inspect to determine the brush length according to the marked change limit
Replace the brush, ensuring adequate pressure on the brush
Return the brushes and install them in the correct position, taking into account the direction of rotation for brush placement
4.
Steps for inspecting the carbon brushes of the excitation system and replacing them if necessary
Wear tested insulating gloves
Measure the brush with the gauge stick and visually inspect to see whether it has reached the marked change limit
Replace the brush, ensuring adequate pressure on the brush
Return the brushes and install them in the correct position, taking into account the direction of rotation for brush placement
Note:
When replacing, the brushes must be replaced one after another, and two brushes must not be replaced at the same time
Ensure that no tools used or anything else are left inside the generator brush housing
Remaining Procedures
Clean the air filter after dismantling it using wrenches
Clean the air dryer filter
Clean the excitation and grounding brush holders
Clean the generator body from the outside
Clean the excitation system room from inside and outside
Inspect the brush holder springs by pressing them and observing the spring-back reaction
